summary: TWO-WEEK WINDOW (Sep 25 - Oct 9; the Oct 2 run was never published). 62 messages, 26 from Lauren. The two halves look very different. FIRST WEEK (to Oct 2): she re-engaged hard. She reported a harasser ('Ryan') who messaged her mother, asked "Did we lose some top spenders?", filled in the new private-platform intake form in under an hour of saying she would, and Ollie came back with 19 messages. But the top-spender question needed a chase ("Can someone tell me what’s happening here?") and was never answered, and Ollie admitted "But we haven't blocked this account". SECOND WEEK (Oct 2 - Oct 9): Ollie sent nothing, and has now been silent 10 days. On Oct 5 Lauren asked three results questions in one sitting: "How are the insights for the page @itsqueenblake", "Can i please get a report on how much we’ve spent on meta ads?" and for a photographer other than Zeus. Only the photographer one was handled (Mica: "just grouped you with someone!"). The meta-ads report is her SECOND written ask (first was Aug 3, 67 days ago, answered then with a promised Derrek call that never happened). The next ALTR message after she asked was an invoice chase ("tomorrow is the deadline") that ignored it. Of the 7 messages ALTR staff sent in the second week, 4 were billing. MONEY: invoice 5 (Sep 15-30) issued Oct 1, chased Oct 2 and Oct 6, paid by wire Oct 7 on the deadline day (~6 days). Paid in full, not late, but slower than invoice 4 (25h) and needed two chases. ALTR thanked her but never confirmed the wire actually landed, which matters given the unaddressed Chase fraud flag (39 days). WINS: weekly leak report on cadence Oct 2 and she thanked for it; Melissa scheduled a reel on 23 repost accounts for Oct 11; the IG farm vendor (Stardust Nexus) posted "2k growth in 2 days using only trial" and she replied "Great work!". CHURN READ: ELEVATED. Present: owner silent 43 days; long-promised ad report still with no written proof (67 days); results questions going unanswered; billing was the majority of ALTR-staff messages in week two. Not present: asks did not collapse (7 distinct asks this window vs 1 the prior week), and payment was not suspiciously fast. No new plaintext credentials posted; the Sep 11-13 ones are still in the scrollback, 28 days unrotated.

health.rationale: Up 9 from the last published score (38, week ending Sep 25). The unpublished mid-window run scored 52 at Oct 2, so the second week gave back about 5 points. Why it is up: engagement recovered (62 messages, 26 client, vs 3 total the prior published week) and she is asking for things again. client_asks = 7 this window (Ryan harassment, 'who is this/what's happening', top spenders, does Beebs still spend, @itsqueenblake insights, meta-ads spend report, a new photographer) against 1 in the week ending Sep 25 (the nuropod link). Asks did not drop to zero, which is the healthy direction. Invoice 5 was paid in full, and the leak report and a repost-network push went out on time. Why it is not higher: (1) Her results questions are not being answered. 'Did we lose some top spenders?' is 11 days open, the @itsqueenblake insights question 3.6 days, and the meta-ads spend report (first asked Aug 3) is now a second written ask, 67 days after the first, with an invoice chase sent the next day instead of an answer. (2) The account manager went dark again: Ollie 0 messages since Sep 29, and zero fan-add/custom requests across the whole window. (3) Owner silence: Derrek 43 days. (4) Structural items unmoved: Chase fraud flag 39 days unacknowledged, credentials 28 days unrotated, boundaries 68 days unconfirmed, CodyBeebs proof 52 days, harasser block unconfirmed 12 days. Payment was a slower, chased payment (2 chases, paid on deadline day), not a fast-clean one, so it is not a churn tell here, but the pace slowed from invoice 4. Churn signals present: owner 30+ days silent (yes, 43); long-promised deliverable with no written proof (yes, ad report 67 days, whale results 64 days); results question answered with a call offer (the original Aug 3 ad-report answer was a call that never came, and the Oct 5 re-ask got no answer at all); most ALTR messages billing (yes in week two: 4 of 7 ALTR-staff messages).
